Kuvitus: keittiön työtaso. Leivänpaahdin: Illustration: a kitchen counter. A toaster is on, and an orange glow shines from its bread slots as the thin heating wires glow. The toaster's cord is plugged into a thick extension cord that runs to a wall socket. The extension cord does not glow.
Kytkentäkaavio resistanssin mittaamiseen: Circuit diagram for measuring resistance, schematic figure. A battery, an ammeter and a resistor R are in the same circuit one after another, that is, in series, so the same current I flows through the ammeter as through the resistor. The voltmeter is connected across the terminals of the resistor, that is, in parallel with the resistor, and it measures the voltage U across the resistor. Purple arrows show the direction of the current from the positive terminal of the battery through the circuit to the negative terminal.
Kaavakuva metallilangan sisältä, ei mitt: Schematic figure of the inside of a metal wire, not to scale. The positive metal ions are in a regular lattice, and the free electrons move among them to the left, when the agreed direction of the current is to the right. In the left panel the wire is at room temperature: the ions vibrate a little, and an electron rarely collides. In the right panel the wire is hot: the ions vibrate strongly, which the wider rings show, and the path of the electron is interrupted more often by collisions. The resistance of the hot wire is greater.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: jännite U volttei: Graph to scale: voltage U in volts as a function of current I in amperes. The characteristic curve of the resistor is a straight line through the origin and through the point (0.30 A; 3.0 V), so its resistance is 10 ohms everywhere. The characteristic curve of the filament lamp is curved: at small voltages it rises gently and at large voltages steeply, and at a voltage of 3.0 V the current of the lamp is 0.25 A. The dashed line from the origin to the point of the lamp shows the resistance of the lamp U : I = 12 ohms at this voltage. The grid spacing is 0.05 A and 0.5 V.
Kaavakuva kolmesta saman aineen langasta: Schematic figure of three wires of the same material, lengths to scale. At the top a wire of length l and cross-sectional area A, and its resistance is R. In the middle a wire twice as long with the same cross-sectional area: the resistance is 2R. At the bottom a wire of the same length with twice the cross-sectional area: the resistance is half, that is, R divided by two. The cross-section is highlighted in orange at the left end of the wire.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: hehkulampun jänni: Graph to scale: voltage U of a filament lamp in volts as a function of current I in amperes. The curve starts at the origin, rises gently at first and then ever more steeply, and ends at the point (0.25 A; 3.0 V). The grid spacing is 0.05 A and 0.5 V.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: vastuksen mittaus: Graph to scale: measurement points of a resistor, voltage U in volts as a function of current I in amperes. The points are (0.020 A; 0.47 V), (0.040 A; 0.86 V), (0.060 A; 1.34 V), (0.080 A; 1.74 V) and (0.100 A; 2.21 V). No line is drawn. The grid spacing is 0.01 A and 0.25 V.
